test_assertions: Durable intent timing completes before broker review.
Submit-to-ack is recorded only for an exact broker acknowledgement.
An acknowledgement never fabricates ack-to-fill latency.
Fill-to-working-protection is recorded only after broker-confirmed working protection.
Failed notification delivery records no false terminal latency.
Latency samples are append-only durable records with correlation metadata.
claim: No production p50, p95, p99, fill, protection, or notification latency is claimed because the full-live service was not started and no live mutation was authorized. Synthetic unit timings validate instrumentation semantics, not broker performance.
